svg.text: Model routing — the mind tags, the host routes
One mechanism, no policy: the engine knows a call is routine or consequential, and never who is paying or what anything costs. Provider, price and table belong to whoever runs the mind.
THE HOST WRITES THE TABLE — WHERE ROUTING IS ACTUALLY DECIDED, AND NONE OF IT IS IN THE ENGINE
THE MIND — EVERY CALL TAGS ITSELF
THE INVARIANTS — WHAT ROUTING MAY NEVER DO

g.text: llm.router — or llm.model as a role map
the cloud gets no privileged interface
the effort gate the mind already runs
host router first, then the role map
first match wins · null = no opinion
a model — a provider only if it moves
no key, bad wire, router threw → default
no engine reads it — not a hidden input
a price cannot change what a mind does
